<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_CreditScoring" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/credit-scoring">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ImmediateResult" name="Immediate scoring result"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DelayNotification" name="Scoring delay notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_FinalResult" name="Final scoring result"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CreditScoring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Banking" name="Banking System" processRef="Process_Banking"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Credit Scoring Agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Request" name="Send scoring request" sourceRef="Task_SendScoringRequest" targetRef="Participant_Agency" messageRef="Msg_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ImmediateResult" name="Immediate result" sourceRef="Participant_Agency" targetRef="Catch_ImmediateResult" messageRef="Msg_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayNotification" name="Delay notification" sourceRef="Participant_Agency" targetRef="Catch_DelayNotification" messageRef="Msg_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FinalResult" name="Final result" sourceRef="Participant_Agency" targetRef="Catch_FinalResult" messageRef="Msg_FinalResult"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Banking" name="Banking System Credit Scoring" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ScoringRequested" name="Credit scoring requested by clerk"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendScoringRequest" name="Send scoring request to agency" messageRef="Msg_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_AwaitScoringResponse" name="Agency response"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ImmediateResult" name="Immediate result received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ImmediateResult" messageRef="Msg_ImmediateResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_DelayNotification" name="Delay notification received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DelayNotification" messageRef="Msg_DelayNotification"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DisplayResult_Immediate" name="Display result to clerk"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DisplayDelayMessage" name="Display message to clerk to check again later"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_FinalResult" name="Final result received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_FinalResult" messageRef="Msg_FinalResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DisplayResult_Final" name="Display result to clerk"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ResultShownImmediate" name="Result shown to clerk"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ResultShownAfterDelay" name="Result shown to clerk after delay"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_ScoringRequested" targetRef="Task_SendScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_SendScoringRequest" targetRef="Gateway_AwaitScoringResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitScoringResponse" targetRef="Catch_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_AwaitScoringResponse" targetRef="Catch_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Catch_ImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_DisplayResult_Immediate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_DisplayResult_Immediate" targetRef="End_ResultShownImmediate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Catch_DelayNotification" targetRef="Task_DisplayDelayMessage"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_DisplayDelayMessage" targetRef="Catch_FinalResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Catch_FinalResult" targetRef="Task_DisplayResult_Final"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_DisplayResult_Final" targetRef="End_ResultShownAfterDelay"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
